messages:
Priya Sharma: Heads up — Aster Labs pushed a renewal today. They want a provisional volume rebate to close: asking 12% on usage for the first 3 months while legal finishes SLA. Invoice pending: INV-2026-PL-448. Can finance sign off a provisional concession?

Ethan Cole: Quick ask — what’s their committed/forecast spend? need to see impact to unit economics. do we have ARR or run-rate numbers?

Priya Sharma: FYI: Q1 actual tokens = 1,800,000,000. Sales forecast Q2 = 2,500,000,000. Current effective price = $0.00035/token. They pushed for 12% to match a competitor offer. Renewal terms otherwise same.

Maya Liu: pinging from finance — run the calc and propose an approval threshold. I can approve up to 10% provisional without exec signoff, per deal desk policy. >10% needs CFO approval. Also need GL impact and whether to apply as credit memo or discount on upcoming invoice.

Priya Sharma: calc I ran:
```
Q1 usage: 1,800,000,000 tokens
Forecast Q2: 2,500,000,000 tokens
Effective price: $0.00035/token
Nominal spend Q2: $875,000
12% rebate = $105,000
10% rebate provisional = $87,500
```
They’re asking for 12% to get to parity; if we offer 10% now, sales risk losing the renewal.

Zoe (Revenue Ops Bot): Reminder: Deal-desk policy v2.1 — provisional concessions <=10% may be approved by Finance Lead. Concessions >10% require Exec (CFO) + Legal signoff. Link: https://redwood.company/ops/deal-desk/policies

Maya Liu: Thanks. Recommend provisional approval of 10% to close now, conditional on:
- Sales documents a clear path to recover (renewal/expansion language),
- Legal to finalize SLA within 30 days,
- Apply as credit memo against next invoice and tag as 'provisional rebate — subject to final SLA'.
If Sales insists on 12% we escalate to CFO.

Ethan Cole: understood. Priya, can you confirm we get an exec note from the AE on why 12% is required and the churn risk? also put the rebate as T&Cs line item in the renewal doc. I’ll prepare the escalation pack if needed.

Priya Sharma: Will do — adding the AE note now and sending draft renewal with rebate clause. Also looping legal: @legal-bot can you expedite SLA review?

legal-bot: Thanks @Priya Sharma — I’ll prioritize review. Please attach the draft SLA and any compliance requirements in this thread. Expect initial comments within 48 hours.

Maya Liu: Approved provisional 10% (finance lead). Condition: issue credit memo for $87,500 against INV-2026-PL-448 to be applied next billing cycle. If legal signs off and CFO approves 12% within 30 days, we’ll issue an adjustment. Marking for accounting and revenue ops. :white_check_mark:

Priya Sharma: Great — thanks Maya. I’ll send the renewal with clause and upload SLA draft. If CFO escalation needed I’ll ping here and attach the impact summary. :thumbsup:

Ethan Cole: thx team. tagging revenue-ops to process the credit once accounting confirms GL code.

Zoe (Revenue Ops Bot): Action items logged: PROV-7892 (provisional rebate), assigned to Priya. Deadline: 2026-05-05 for SLA + CFO decision.

Priya Sharma: closing loop — credit memo request submitted to accounting (txn ref CR-2026-998). will update when posted.

Maya Liu: please follow up once credit posted. leaving thread open until SLA signed OR CFO decision.
